fidelity.summary:
Visual-fidelity pass over the 8 reference routes against the real imported content. Measured every route at 1440/390 (plus home at 768/1023/1024/1920) with Playwright and compared value-by-value with discovery/measure/results.json + interact.json; composed side-by-side images and inspected each. After the fixes, header, heroes (765/540/630/373 @1440, 717/506/591/386 @390), h1 sizes (72/60/36 with the md
), mission 467, feature cards 378.66 gap 40 with 64px wells, BarKode band 640 with the 448px tile, testimonial 1024 (2/5+3/5, h-64 media on mobile), overlap cards (-64px, 1024/896 wide, r16, shadow-xl), timeline (2x488 gap 48, 32px badges hanging ±16 over the spine, 96px offset), contact split + form controls (48px inputs, r2, 14/500 labels, 120px textarea, navy 56px submit), footer (4x268 gap 48, logo 80, desc max 320, italic tagline, bottom bar) and the open mobile menu match the reference to the pixel; only content-driven differences remain (longer live copy, 5 program steps, more footer links, teams block, address/hours rows, etc.). Theme fixes made: stars pattern now foreground-coloured (reference draws it with currentColor = near-invisible dark stars; patterns became token-driven CSS masks), BarKode caption in Fraunces with tracking, footer tagline pt-2 spacing + WCAG-AA tint #dd7788 (4.55:1, recomputed by hk9_accessible_tint() when the palette changes), CTA arrow only on the navy band primary (16px) and single-button rows no longer stretched on mobile, trailing button icons get the reference ml-2, testimonial.php reads hk9_-prefixed story meta, LCP images (hero/legacy/featured) eager+fetchpriority=high with the header logo eager-only and everything else lazy, accurate srcset sizes for team/story/partner images, core's sizes="auto" stripped for explicit theme sizes (it also broke the screenshot tool), footer social links rendered as brand icons (facebook/instagram/youtube/linkedin glyphs added; X falls back to text; no more close-icon for X), legal menu de-coupled from the social row, gallery caption clamp (axe serious on /photos/ → none), redundant alt on partner logos removed, hero entrance animation made slide-only like the reference (removes a transient axe contrast finding), and theme/heartland-k9s/screenshot.png (1200x900) captured. Wrote docs/visual-comparison.md (method, per-route tables, compare.mjs + region-aligned diff numbers, deviations, health) and copied 13 side-by-side composites into docs/reports/screenshots/side-by-side/. Final state: debug.log 0 bytes, 0 console errors, 0 external requests on 16 URLs, axe clean on the 8 routes, no horizontal overflow at any width.

The theme now omits 'auto' for images with an explicit sizes, which makes the captures stable; block-content galleries (/photos/) can still be affected — awaiting img.decode() again after the loading flip in the tool would fix it generically.

tools/axe.mjs scans immediately after networkidle; any opacity entrance animation registers as a transient contrast failure. The reference hero animation is slide-only (no fade), so the theme was changed to match; documented in docs/visual-comparison.md §6/§11.

I accidentally ran the full tools/axe.mjs once with default output, which created docs/reports/axe.md (did not exist before); I deleted it again so no file outside my area was left behind. docs/reports/diffs/report.md was regenerated by tools/compare.mjs as instructed.

Pixel-diff percentages in compare.mjs remain high (8–64%) because every route is taller than the reference for content reasons (longer live copy, 5 program steps, extra footer links, teams block, address rows); the region-aligned diffs in the doc (header/hero/footer bar ≤ 3%) show the actual rendering fidelity.

Deliberate deviations kept and documented: BarKode tile visible on mobile (reference collapses it), footer tagline tint #dd7788 for WCAG AA, brand social icons (reference has none; X renders as text), gallery captions clamped to 4 lines, sizes="auto" stripped for theme images, single-button CTA rows inline on mobile (as reference), wave-2 deviations (mobile timeline order, sr-only ways heading, stories section headers).

Partner logo `sizes` on the Back-the-Pack panel still favours the 300w candidate on desktop (tiles are ~58px wide inside a 6-column panel); harmless but could be tightened if the panel grid is ever given its own sizes.

The reference measurement for home@768 was taken at a 900px-tall viewport while tools/screenshot.mjs captures 768 at 1024px, so the archived home-768 capture shows an 870px hero; measured at 900 vh the theme's hero is 765 like the reference (noted in the doc).
fidelity.integration_notes: New/changed theme contract surface: (1) CSS token --hk9-secondary-on-primary (default #dd7788 = secondary lightened to 4.5:1 on primary); inc/options.php exposes hk9_relative_luminance(), hk9_contrast_ratio(), hk9_accessible_tint($hex, $bg, $target=4.5) and hk9_root_css() re-emits the token whenever colors.primary/secondary differ from the defaults — use it for any crimson text on navy. (2) Background patterns (.hk9-pattern--grid/--stars) are now CSS masks: ::before is background-color currentColor (grid) / var(--hk9-fg) (stars) with -webkit-mask/mask; any new pattern should follow the same pattern (colour follows tokens). (3) hk9_button() marks trailing icons with .hk9-btn__icon (margin-left .5rem = reference ml-2); cta_band.php adds .hk9-cta-band__actions--multi when 2 buttons render (only then do buttons stretch below 640px) and puts the arrow only on navy-tone primary buttons. (4) hk9_image(): strips core's leading 'auto,' from sizes when an explicit sizes attr is passed; pass 'fetchpriority' => 'auto' to opt an eager image out of core's first-eager-image=high heuristic (attribute is removed from the output); hk9_logo_img('header') is eager without priority. Hero/legacy/featured parts call hk9_image(…, true) for eager+high. (5) hk9_pages_team_card(WP_Post $post, array $args = []) accepts 'sizes'; teams.php passes 496px (≤2 teams) / 320px (3 cols). Story cards use 496px, partner logos '(max-width:767px) calc(50vw − 56px), 160px' and no sr-only duplicate name. (6) inc/icons.php: hk9_icon_brand_extras() (facebook, instagram, youtube, linkedin; lucide ISC shapes) merged after the sprite so a sprite rebuild with the same names wins; footer.php maps socials to icon names ('brand-x' for X → text fallback). (7) footer.php legal menu now uses .hk9-footer__legal (was reusing .hk9-footer__social); .hk9-footer__social a is a 32px icon link. (8) testimonial.php reads story meta via hk9_pages_text() (hk9_-prefixed / plugin accessor). (9) _hero.scss entrance animation is slide-only (700ms ease, delays 0/150/300/500) to match the reference and keep axe deterministic. (10) _pages-migrated.scss clamps core gallery figcaptions (-webkit-line-clamp 4, overflow hidden). (11) theme/heartland-k9s/screenshot.png added; readme.txt describes how to re-capture it. Docs: docs/visual-comparison.md is the report of record (method, per-route tables, deviations, health); side-by-side composites live in docs/reports/screenshots/side-by-side/. Scratch tooling (measure-wp.mjs, cmp.mjs, compose.mjs, region-diff.mjs, probe.mjs) is in the session scratchpad wave3/ folder if anyone wants to re-run the measurement comparison. Suggested follow-ups outside my area: make tools/screenshot.mjs await img.decode() after flipping loading (block-content galleries), and have tools/axe.mjs wait ~1.5s or emulate prefers-reduced-motion before scanning.

importerFix.summary:
Fixed the shared-attachment instability (Problem 1), verified/hardened the finalize behaviour for server-path payloads and documented production payload placement (Problem 2), confirmed the Reading step + posts page (Problem 3), extended the mini fixture + suite, and repaired the 10 legacy shared attachments on the shared site so the real payload now dry-runs clean.

PROBLEM 1 — root cause: when a second payload record had byte-identical bytes to an earlier one, `MediaFiles` adopted the same attachment through the normal Reconcile path and applied the second record's title/alt/caption/date, so the first record's stored `db` hashes no longer matched (re-run: `media_files conflict=10`; rollback: "skipped … modified: title, alt"). Fix (plugin/heartland-k9s-core/src/Import/**):
- `Map`: new `rows_for_object()`, `owner()` (oldest active row bound to an object = owner; the creating row is always reserved first so it is the oldest), `delete_by_object()`, `rows_by_sha()` (ordered by id); `get_by_object()` now ORDER BY id; dead `find_by_sha()` removed.
- `Steps/MediaFiles`: dedupe now walks `rows_by_sha()` (skipping the record's own row / deleted objects); if the attachment is owned by another key the record goes through a new `secondary()` path that writes NOTHING to the post, binds the row with `created_by_run=NULL` and field hashes `{db: owner's db hash (fallback: live value), src: hash(own desired)}` — so both rows hash-match the object, re-runs skip, editor edits surface as a conflict on the owner only, `--overwrite` re-syncs. Dry runs remember the would-be creator per sha (`state['dry_created']`) so the duplicate is reported `skip`, not `create` (State/Runner reset + status unset added). Sensitive owner keys are masked in log lines.
- `Steps/MediaSizes`: dry run reports `skip` for the shared duplicate; dry-run verdict now uses `wp_get_missing_image_subsizes()` instead of "count of registered sizes" (the real payload previously showed `media_sizes update=171` in dry runs for small images that can never get every size).
- `Steps/Finalize`: a secondary record never re-parents a shared attachment (info line); server-path payloads get an explicit "left in place" log line.
- `Rollback`: an object bound to several rows is decided once (`$handled` set): `modified_across()` treats a field as modified only if its current hash matches NONE of the rows' db hashes; deletion is logged "(also bound to …)" and `delete_by_object()` drops every row bound to it; later rows for the same object are skipped in that rollback.

PROBLEM 2: `Finalize::cleanup()` only ever deletes `uploads/hk9-payload-*` (`Payload::is_uploaded_dir()` gate), so the read-only bind mount `/var/www/html/wp-content/hk9-payload` (`touch` → "Read-only file system") is never touched; verified debug.log stays empty (0 bytes) across the real dry runs and the earlier real runs' finalize logs show no delete attempt. The CLI warning is kept (it is correct). docs/importer.md §8.1 now documents production placement: upload the ZIP via Heartland → Setup & Import (random `uploads/hk9-payload-*` dir with deny rules, deleted after a clean run) or CLI with a directory outside the web root; explains the dev-mount warning.

PROBLEM 3: on the shared site `page_for_posts=1452` = the `new:page:news` page (published, slug `news`), `show_on_front=page`, `page_on_front=1457`; `curl http://localhost:8093/news/` → HTTP 200 with `<body class="blog …">` (WordPress' is_home → theme `home.php`; the page renders `.hk9-hero--blog` + empty-list card). The suite now asserts the same for the mini fixture (`/mini-news/`).

Shared-site repair (needed so the real dry run could ever report conflict 0): the 10 pairs had been left with the SECOND record's values by the old code. A one-off script (dry-run first, then apply, then deleted) restored each secondary row's pre-image onto the attachment only for fields whose current hash still equalled the secondary's stored hash (untouched since), then re-mirrored the secondary rows' hashes onto the owners' and cleared their before_data. Result: all owner rows hash-match; real `--dry-run` now `media_files 0 0 250 0 0`, everything else skip; `wp hk9 rollback --run=20260911-153815-loyqrsbg --dry-run` → 352 deleted, 7 restored, 0 skipped (10 log lines "also bound to …"). Net content change on the shared site: attachments #1210, #1264 (alt+date), #1235, #1250, #1274, #1330, #1333, #1334, #1335 (date), #1287 (title/alt: logo now carries live:media:3028's title "Concept 1 rocker outlined (2)" and empty alt — first record wins by manifest order; the theme falls back to the site name for the logo alt).

Also fixed: the suite refused to run / would have truncated the whole map and unset real settings leaves on a site holding the real import. It is now mini-scoped (only `mini:*` rows are cleaned, the opt run is rolled back, `contact.hours` is restored to its exact prior value). During the first run a quoting slip left the literal `"$base_hours"` in `contact.hours` for ~2 minutes; I restored the real value ("8:00am – 5:00pm") immediately and verified it hash-matches the real import row.

tests.evidence: php -l on every file under src/Import and src/Import/Steps: no syntax errors.

issues: Shared-site content change (deliberate, needed to reach a consistent state): 10 attachments had their title/alt/date restored to the FIRST record's values (undoing the old bug). Most notably the logo attachment #1287 (used as branding.header_logo/footer_logo) now carries live:media:3028's metadata: title 'Concept 1 rocker outlined (2)', empty alt (the theme falls back to the site name for alt), because live:media:3028 precedes ref:asset:heartland-k9s-logo in manifest order. Recommendation for the payload builder owner: dedupe byte-identical media at build time (or order ref:asset records before live:media duplicates) so the record with the better metadata is the owner.

During the first suite run a quoting slip wrote the literal string "$base_hours" into hk9_settings contact.hours on the shared site for about two minutes; it was restored to '8:00am – 5:00pm' immediately and verified to hash-match the real import's map row. The suite also temporarily switches page_on_front/page_for_posts to the mini pages while it runs (restored by its rollback), as it always did.

wp hk9 reset-state (run by the suite) clears the import state option; the last real dry run re-populated it, so `wp hk9 status` now shows the dry run 20260911-160826-nsc9zn8z as the current run (run history intact). Run history only keeps 20 entries, so the suite's ~19 runs pushed today's earlier real-run entries out of `hk9_import_runs` (the map rows and logs are untouched; rollback still works by run id).
media_sizes dry-run verdict change (wp_get_missing_image_subsizes) is a behaviour change to reporting only; real runs are unchanged.
The CLI warning text about the web root lives in src/CLI/ImportCommand.php (outside my area) and was left as is; docs/importer.md explains it instead.
Secondary records never re-parent a shared attachment (their `parent` is ignored with an info log line); none of the real payload's 10 pairs carry a parent, so this has no effect today.
importerFix.integration_notes: No commits were made (per instructions); all changes are in the working tree on branch build/wordpress-conversion. Other agents' uncommitted theme changes (theme/heartland-k9s/**) were left untouched. New Map API: Map::rows_for_object(type,id), Map::owner(type,id), Map::delete_by_object(type,id), Map::rows_by_sha(sha); Map::find_by_sha() was removed (it had one caller, MediaFiles). New run-state key `dry_created` (State::blank, reset in Runner::resume, hidden from Runner::status like `prehash`). Map rows of secondary attachment records have created_by_run=NULL and mirror the owner's db hashes; a rollback that deletes a shared attachment removes every row bound to it (the secondaries simply re-adopt on the next import). The mini fixture gained mini:asset:card-copy (tools/fixtures/payload-mini/media-index.json + media/ + history page image block; rebuilt into plugin/heartland-k9s-core/tests/payload-mini with `node tools/build-payload.mjs --src=tools/fixtures/payload-mini --out=plugin/heartland-k9s-core/tests/payload-mini --media-index=tools/fixtures/payload-mini/media-index.json --copy-media`). The suite is now safe to run on a site holding the real import (mini-scoped precondition/cleanup, no Map::truncate, opt run rolled back, contact.hours restored exactly); run it with `bash plugin/heartland-k9s-core/tests/importer-suite.sh` (takes ~3 minutes, curls http://localhost:8093 — override with HK9_SITE_URL). Production installs: place the payload via the admin ZIP upload or a CLI path outside the web root (docs/importer.md §8.1).

fields.verdict: Security posture is sound (nonces + edit_post caps on every write path, auth_callback on all meta, private fields absent from REST, hk9_* meta marked protected, picker enforces per-type and per-post caps, all admin output escaped, $_POST unslashed before sanitizing). Revision/preview design fixes F1-F7 are implemented and verified by the suite (33/33 PASS). One HIGH correctness bug reproduced: single-select sanitizer emits '' which fails the REST enum schema, so a block-editor Update 400s ("Updating failed") after title/content were already persisted. Fix that before merge; the rest are medium/low hardening items.

findings.issue: Sanitizer/schema mismatch (violates §4 'output always passes the schema' and re-opens judge F3). sanitize() line 67 lets '' through (`&& '' !== $value`) while schema() lines 75-83 builds an enum without ''. Renderer line 111 offers a '— Select —' empty option on every non-required select, so an editor can pick it (57 enum properties affected, e.g. hk9_sec_hero_band.pattern). Reproduced: sanitize(['pattern'=>'']) → '' → rest_validate_value_from_schema fails 'not one of none, stars, grid'; REST PUT of that object → 400 after wp_update_post already ran. Classic save stores '' and then every later block-editor save 400s.
findings.fix: In sanitize() (single branch) return $default whenever `$has_opts && ! isset( $options[ $value ] )` (drop the `'' !== $value` exception); in render() skip the placeholder option when the field default is non-empty (or add '' to the enum only for fields whose default is ''). Add a test that sanitizes '' for every enum property of every registered key and validates against the schema.

findings.issue: names() (lines 66-90) falls back to a 26-name FALLBACK list when hk9_icon_name_list() is empty (theme sprite missing / plugin running without the theme, which §1 requires to work) and caches it statically; sanitize() then clears any stored icon not in that list on the next save/REST round-trip — silent data loss.

findings.issue: valid_id() (34-54) and Link::valid_post_id() accept any non-trashed post of the type regardless of the current user's capability; Rest/Pick filters by edit_post but a direct REST meta write bypasses it (e.g. an editor without hk9_barkode caps can attach any barkode id to a team). findings.issue: is_default_write() for hk9_sections_layout only treats {order:[],hidden:[]} as default (line 341-342), so the first classic/meta-box save always materializes the layout even when it equals the reference order; and when a REST PUT also switches the template, template_default() still reads the old template (template is written after rest_pre_insert), so untouched new-template defaults get stored. forms.verdict: Solid implementation that meets ARCHITECTURE §10 on header injection, nonce/honeypot/time-trap/token/rate-limit, PII handling, storage isolation and accessibility. Two medium-high issues should be fixed before launch: both end with the visitor being told "We have already received this submission" when nothing was received (token consumed before send; token/nonce baked into cacheable HTML). Remaining items are medium/low hardening.

findings.issue: Antispam::mark_used($token) runs before Submissions::store()/Mailer::send(). When wp_mail fails and storage is off (or a fatal occurs mid-pipeline) the visitor gets code=send_failed with refresh=null, and every retry with the same page returns 409 duplicate: 'We have already received this submission. Thank you!' — a false success for a message that was never stored or mailed.
findings.fix: Move mark_used() after the store/mail step succeeds (or delete_transient('hk9_form_used_'.$key) on send_failed), and return 'refresh' => Antispam::issue($form_id) in the send_failed Result so the JS/no-JS retry works.

findings.issue: hk9_nonce, hk9_ts and the single-use hk9_token are rendered into page HTML with no cache exclusion (nocache_headers only on ?hk9_form= result URLs). Behind any full-page cache/CDN every visitor receives the same token: the first submit consumes it and all later visitors get 409 'already received' (false), after 6 h 'expired', after 12–24 h a nonce 403. Real message loss on typical managed WP hosting.
findings.fix: Add GET hk9/v1/forms/{id}/token (Cache-Control: no-store) that returns {nonce, ts, token}; have forms-frontend.js refresh the hidden fields at init. For the no-JS path define DONOTCACHEPAGE / nocache_headers() when hk9_render_form() runs. Reword the duplicate message neutrally ('This form was already submitted from this page — please reload and try again').

findings.issue: client_ip() uses REMOTE_ADDR only (correctly immune to X-Forwarded-For spoofing), but behind a reverse proxy/CDN that does not rewrite REMOTE_ADDR all visitors share one IP, so after forms.rate_limit (5) successful sends per hour the form is closed site-wide. Only an undocumented code filter hk9/forms/client_ip exists.
findings.fix: Add a forms.trusted_proxy (off by default) setting that reads a single configured header only when REMOTE_ADDR matches a listed proxy IP/CIDR, plus a deployment note; alternatively key the limit on ip_hash + token issuer.

findings.issue: When storage is on and wp_mail() fails, the visitor sees the success state and the only signal is the 'Not sent' badge inside a record nobody is alerted to; there is no admin notice/count and no failure hook. Mailer::send() also returns false silently (no log) when recipients() is empty.
findings.fix: Add a dismissible admin notice / dashboard count of _hk9_mail_sent=0 in the last 7 days, log the empty-recipient case, and fire do_action('hk9/forms/mail_failed', $submission_id, $error) for retry integrations.

findings.issue: handle_admin_post() persists an error transient (up to ~5.5 KB of typed values) for every failed unauthenticated POST, including nonce/token failures, with no failure rate limit. Rows outlive the 5-min TTL until WP's daily expired-transient GC, so a bot flood bloats wp_options and typed PII lingers in the DB up to ~24 h when the visitor never follows the redirect.
findings.fix: Store values only when the nonce and token were valid (values=[] for nonce/token/expired like honeypot), cap stored values (e.g. mb_substr message to 2000), and purge expired hk9_form_res_* rows in the retention cron.

findings.issue: is_used()/mark_used() are non-atomic (get_transient then set_transient), so two simultaneous no-JS submits with the same token both pass and send twice.
findings.fix: Claim the token atomically: if ( ! add_option('_transient_hk9_form_used_'.$key, 1, '', 'no') ) treat as duplicate (or $wpdb INSERT IGNORE / wp_cache_add when an object cache is present).

findings.issue: run_retention() uses post_status=>'any', which excludes trash, so trashed submissions older than retention_days are only removed by core's EMPTY_TRASH_DAYS purge. ip_hash uses a daily salt, so the rate-limit key changes at UTC midnight (up to 2x limit across the boundary).
findings.fix: Use post_status => ['publish','private','draft','trash'] in the retention query; derive the rate-limit key from a salt with a longer period (or ip + hour bucket) independent of the stored ip_hash.

findings.issue: Only rest_cookie_invalid_nonce triggers the native fallback; any other non-plugin REST error (security plugins returning rest_login_required/rest_disabled, rest_no_route without pretty permalinks) surfaces WordPress's raw error text in the summary instead of falling back to admin-post.php.
findings.fix: Fall back with nativeSubmit(form) whenever the response lacks the plugin envelope (typeof data.ok !== 'boolean' || !data.mode).

findings.issue: Accessibility/i18n nits: the '*' required indicator is aria-hidden with no visible legend explaining it; rendering the same form twice on one page consumes the error transient on the first render and emits two autofocus attributes; placeholders 'John', 'Doe', 'john@example.com' are not translatable.
findings.fix: Add a '* Required' note above the grid; delete the error transient after the page render (shutdown hook) rather than in render(); wrap placeholders in __().

theme.verdict: PASS with fixes recommended. Security posture is clean (every dynamic echo is escaped or routed through escaping helpers; no frontend HTTP; sprite read from disk with is_readable guard + built-in fallback; no href="#"; target=_blank always carries rel; no debug leftovers). Theme runs without the plugin (verified). BarKode single leaks nothing beyond the record's own public fields. Main defects are performance (N+1 on every record listing, unbounded queries) plus a few a11y/i18n/dead-code items.

findings.issue: N+1 queries in record listings. Measured after wp_cache_flush(): teams 2 records→10 queries, campaigns 5→27, people 11→31, partners 13→37 (~2 extra queries per record). Cause: hk9_rec_query() iterates $query->posts directly so thumbnail attachments are never primed (each card's hk9_image() does get_post + postmeta for the attachment); hk9_rec_by_ids() calls _prime_post_caches($ids,false,false) so meta (hk9_website, _thumbnail_id) is fetched per post; campaign cards call hk9_rec_sponsor_logos() per card, re-priming sponsors per campaign.
findings.fix: In hk9_rec_query() call update_post_thumbnail_cache($query) before returning. In hk9_rec_by_ids() use _prime_post_caches($ids,false,true) then prime thumbnails: _prime_post_caches(array_filter(array_map('get_post_thumbnail_id',$out)),false,true). In template-parts/sections/campaigns_list.php collect all sponsor ids across $hk9_posts and prime them once before the card loop.

findings.issue: Unbounded queries: hk9_rec_query() hardcodes posts_per_page => -1 (line ~829) for people/partners/teams/campaigns; the plugin-less events fallback hk9_rec_events() loads every hk9_event then filters upcoming/past in PHP and only slices afterwards.
findings.fix: Add a filterable cap (e.g. apply_filters('hk9/theme/rec_query_limit', 200)) as the default posts_per_page; for the events fallback pass posts_per_page => $count and a meta_query on hk9_end/hk9_start >= current_time('Y-m-d') (or <= for past) instead of PHP filtering.

findings.issue: Social links (lines ~55-60): assets/dist/icons.svg contains no facebook/instagram/youtube/linkedin symbols, so hk9_icon() returns '' and the visible text label is printed AND the screen-reader-text span → screen readers announce 'Facebook Facebook'. The 'x' key resolves to lucide's close-X glyph, so X/Twitter renders as a '×' close icon.
findings.fix: Add brand symbols to the sprite build (tools/build-icons.mjs; e.g. simple-icons paths) and map the X key to a distinct name like 'x-social'; only emit the screen-reader span when an icon was rendered (else the visible label already names the link).

findings.issue: hk9_rec_gallery() (line ~1276) runs wp_attachment_is_image() per id before any cache priming → get_post + get_attached_file meta query per image (used by story galleries, gallery template, BarKode ID cards).
findings.fix: Call _prime_post_caches($ids, false, true) before the array_filter; then the per-id checks and hk9_image() hit the object cache.
